concepts.name: TypeScript Vessel
concepts.description: An independently deployable TypeScript service that advertises shapes, acts as a resolver, acts as a client, registers with discovery-vessel, records traces, and optionally observes passively
key_characteristics: Advertises shapes - declares impulse types it resolves
Acts as client - queries discovery-vessel for impulses

concepts.name: Three Load-Bearing Invariants
concepts.description: Critical requirements that must be maintained for deployment stability

invariants.name: Non-blocking registration
invariants.description: Vessel MUST keep serving requests if discovery-vessel is unreachable

invariants.name: Shape-dispatch agreement
invariants.description: config.discovery.shapes array must match switch(pointer.type) cases

invariants.name: WebSocket observer safety
invariants.description: Observer must never throw into reconnect loop, wrap handlers in try/catch

concepts.name: Standard Directory Structure
concepts.description: Concrete skeleton for organizing vessel code and deployment

src/.routes/: impulses.ts for shape dispatch, feature routes
src/.resolvers/: One module per shape, business logic only
src/.lifecycle/: In-process event emitter for CRUD events

concepts.name: Typed Configuration Pattern
concepts.description: Structured approach to environment-based configuration with explicit typing

concepts.name: Discovery Client Pattern
concepts.description: Singleton class managing vessel registration, heartbeat, and shutdown with discovery-vessel

concepts.name: Shape Advertisement and Dispatch
concepts.description: Contract between advertised capabilities and actual implementation
components: thin glue layer with no business logic

concepts.name: Passive Execution Observer
concepts.description: Optional WebSocket connection to learn from executions the vessel wasn't called in

concepts.name: Authentication Middleware
concepts.description: JWT and API key validation through identity-vessel
auth_types: API key: Long-lived keys with read/write scopes

concepts.name: Internal Lifecycle Hooks
concepts.description: In-process event system for own-CRUD events

concepts.name: Helm Deployment Requirements
concepts.description: Required configuration for proper Kubernetes deployment
requirements: POD_NAME via fieldRef for stable vessel ID

concepts.name: Common Anti-Patterns to Avoid
avoid: Gating registration behind unprovisioned env vars

concepts.name: Pre-Release Validation Checklist
concepts.description: Required validations before cutting first vessel release

relationships.description: Vessel implementation must adhere to three invariants
Discovery client implements non-blocking registration invariant
Shape dispatch implements shape-dispatch agreement invariant
Directory structure provides home for config pattern
Helm wiring provides environment variables for typed config
